summary: Seattle, self-taught programmer, CEO of own company for 14 years, strong interest in Python and web frameworks (especially web2py), experienced in embedded systems and compiler implementation, has two handicapped children requiring round-the-clock care, anti-illegal immigration stance, pro-legal immigration, critical of Java programming language, avid reader and supporter of open-source projects, has a background in technical writing, former Microsoft employee, enjoys strategy games, has a strong interest in DIY projects and technology, has a family structure that includes a spouse who is an immigrant.
